title: A bill to amend the Dayton Aviation Heritage Preservation Act of 1992 to adjust the boundary of the Dayton Aviation Heritage National Historical Park, and for other purposes.

la.text: Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.

actions.t: Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.
Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources discharged by Unanimous Consent.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

summaries.html: This bill adjusts the boundary of the Dayton Aviation Heritage National Historical Park to include approximately one acre of land in Dayton, Ohio.
